test_title: SSC Selection Post Matric Level Official Paper (Held on: 3 Aug 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Who among the following rulers of the Suri dynasty defeated the Mughal emperor Humayun?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Sher Shah Suri.__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Sher Shah Suri **the Ruler of the Suri Dynasty defeated the Mughal Emperor **Humayun**.
 
• Shershah Suri defeated Mughal Emperor in the **Battle of Chausa in the year 1539 and the battle of Kannauj in the year 1540.**
 
• Shēr Shah ruled the whole of north India for five years, annexing Malwa and defeating the Rajputs.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__

 
• Sher Shah Suri setup a new economic and Military administration and Issued the first **Rupiya Tanka.**
 
• The greatest achievement of Sher Shah Suri was his **Land Revenue System.**
 
• The **Grand Trunk Road **or **GT Road **was built by **Shershah Suri.**
 
• **The Grand Trunk Road **connect Kolkata to Peshawar.
